item.title: Veterans & Military Resources in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
Veterans & Military Resources in Anne Arundel County

Military Installations & Communities

Major Military Installations

Naval Academy (Annapolis):

Basic Facts:

  • Location: 110 Taylor Avenue, Annapolis, MD 21402
  • Phone: 410-293-0111
  • Website: www.usna.edu
  • Population: ~4,500 midshipmen, 600+ faculty/staff
  • Founded: 1845

Community Impact:

  • Major employer in Annapolis
  • Tourism and economic benefits
  • Strong military-civilian community ties
  • Many civilians work at Naval Academy

Housing:

  • OCS (Officer Career School): Some housing available
  • Bachelors: Limited, typically unmarried
  • Families: Most live off-base in Annapolis/neighborhoods
  • On-base housing: Apply through Housing Office

item.title: Veterans & Military Resources in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
Veterans & Military Resources in Anne Arundel County

Estimated reading time: 6 minutes

Anne Arundel County has a significant military presence, with Fort Meade (NSA headquarters), Joint Base Andrews, and Naval Academy nearby. If you’re a veteran or military family, there are plenty of resources available - but you need to know where to look and what’s actually available to you.

Military Installations Nearby

Fort Meade

Home to the National Security Agency and major military commands. This is the largest military installation in the county.

item.title: VA Benefits for Veterans in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
VA Benefits for Veterans in Anne Arundel County

Veterans living in Anne Arundel County have access to extensive VA benefits. From healthcare to education to housing assistance, this guide covers what’s available near Fort Meade and Joint Base Andrews.

VA Healthcare System

VA Medical Facilities Near Anne Arundel

Baltimore VA Medical Center - Primary facility for Anne Arundel veterans

  • Address: 2901 W. Lanham Avenue, Baltimore, MD 21215
  • Phone: 410-455-5000
  • Full medical services
  • About 30-40 minutes from most of Anne Arundel
  • Official VA Facilities: va.gov/health-care/find-locations

Fort Meade VA Clinic - Primary care on post

item.title: Military Employment & Career Resources
item.description:
Military Employment & Career Resources

Military families in Anne Arundel County have unique employment challenges and opportunities. From military spouse employment to veteran hiring preferences to transition support, this guide covers career resources.

Employment Near Fort Meade

Fort Meade Employers

NSA (National Security Agency):

  • Major employer at Fort Meade
  • Federal positions available
  • Clearance preferred but not always required
  • Competitive federal benefits

Military Installations:

  • Civilian positions at military bases
  • Federal employment benefits
  • Security clearance may be required
  • Apply through USAJobs
